It was founded in 2000 by [[Vijay Shekhar Sharma]]. {{cite news|url=https://www.etnownews.com/markets/paytm-q1-results-fy-2025-26-date-time-vijay-shekhar-sharmas-one97-communications-quarterly-earnings-schedule-details-article-152270567|title=Paytm Q1 Results FY 2025-26 date, time: Vijay Shekhar Sharma's One97 Communications' quarterly earnings schedule details|publisher=Times}} Through its subsidiaries and businesses, the company offers digital payment and financial services to consumers and merchants in India. It also provides mobile [[advertising]], [[marketing]] and [[payments]] for [[merchants]]. In 2021, the company became [[Public company|publicly listed]] after the largest ever initial public offering (IPO) in India's history. It was listed on Indian stock exchanges on 08 November 2021. == History == One97 Communications Limited was founded in 2000 by [[Vijay Shekhar Sharma]] in [[New Delhi]]. The company is headquartered in [[Noida]], India.{{cite news |last1=Verma |first1=Shrutika |title=Vijay Shekhar Sharma: The 'no cash' champion |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/vKaVaFIZv8d2PGrt1G5L0H/Vijay-Shekhar-Sharma-The-no-cash-champion.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=2 December 2016}} It launched [[Paytm]] in 2009 as a digital payments platform to facilitate cashless payments.{{cite news |last1=Joseph |first1=Lancelot |title=Flexing its technology muscle |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/paytm-super-app |publisher=[[Business India]] |date=23 August 2021}} It owns various businesses and subsidiaries – Paytm Payments Bank, Paytm Payments Gateway, Paytm Payout, Paytm Money, Paytm Insider, Paytm Insurance, Paytm Postpaid, Paytm for Business, Paytm Credit Cards, and Paytm First Games.{{cite news |last1=Rai |first1=Saritha |title=One97's Paytm banks on the future of mobile wallets |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/work-in-progress/one97s-paytm-banks-on-the-future-of-mobile-wallets/41559/1 |work=[[Forbes India]] |date=18 November 2015}} ==Divisions== ===Paytm Money=== '''Paytm Money''' is an Indian wealth-technology platform and stock broker, operating as a division of One97 Communications, the parent company of [[Paytm]]. Headquartered in Delhi, it offers retail investors access to equities, derivatives, mutual funds, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), initial public offerings (IPOs), fixed income instruments, and retirement products. Paytm Money was incorporated in 2017 as a wholly owned subsidiary of One97 Communications, and launched in 2018 with direct mutual fund investments.{{cite web |title=Paytm sets up investment and wealth management unit for its users |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/paytm-sets-up-investment-and-wealth-management-unit-for-its-users-118011000024_1.html |website=Business Standard |date=10 January 2018 |access-date=25 September 2025}} Between 2019 and 2021, the platform included stock broking, retirement products, and futures & options trading.{{cite web |title=Paytm To Launch Investor Dedicated mutual funds Buying App Paytm Money |url=https://www.franchiseindia.com/insights/en/article/paytm-to-launch-investor-dedicated-mutual-funds-buying-app-paytm-money.50760 |website=Franchise India |date=15 January 2018 |access-date=25 September 2025}} In 2023, the company introduced a bonds investment platform and reported profitability for FY 2022–23, citing brokerage income growth.{{cite web |title=Paytm Money In The Black, Posts INR 42.8 Cr Profit In FY23 |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/paytm-money-in-the-black-posts-inr-42-8-cr-profit-in-fy23/ |website=Inc42 |date=6 July 2023 |access-date=25 September 2025}}{{cite web |title=Paytm Money posts Rs 40 Cr profit in FY23, scale grows 2X |url=https://entrackr.com/2023/09/paytm-money-posts-rs-40-cr-profit-in-fy23-scale-grows-2x/ |website=Entrackr |date=18 September 2023 |access-date=25 September 2025}}{{cite web |title=Paytm Q4FY23 Revenue Rises To ₹2,334 Cr, Operating Profit Jumps 3X QoQ To ₹101 Cr |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/magazine/business/story/paytm-q4fy23-revenue-rises-to-2334-cr-operating-profit-jumps-3x-qoq-to-101-cr-6764 |website=Outlook Business |date=6 May 2023 |access-date=25 September 2025}} ===Paytm Travel=== '''Paytm Travel''' is the online travel services division of One97 Communications, the parent company of [[Paytm]]. Headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, it provides booking solutions for flights, trains, buses and hotels, including Tatkal train tickets and international flights.{{cite news |title=Paytm announces free cancellation for train tickets including Tatkal |url=https://www.thehansindia.com/tech/paytm-announces-free-cancellation-for-train-tickets-including-tatkal-tickets-details-827497 |work=The Hans India |date=17 September 2023 |access-date=20 September 2025}} The travel division is headed by Vikash Jalan as CEO.{{cite web |title=Paytm Travel official website |url=https://tickets.paytm.com/ |access-date=20 September 2025}} Initially began with railway ticket booking with the [[Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation|IRCTC]], the company launched a travel marketplace, starting with bus ticket bookings in 2015 through aggregator partnerships.{{cite news |title=Paytm launches bus ticket marketplace |url=https://www.pymnts.com/news/2015/paytm-launches-bus-ticket-marketplace/ |work=PYMNTS |date=July 2015 |access-date=20 September 2025}}{{cite news |title=IRCTC partners with Paytm to simplify train bookings October 2023 |access-date=20 September 2025}} In 2019, Paytm acquired NightStay, a last-minute hotel booking platform, marking its entry into the hospitality segment.{{cite news |title=Paytm forays |access-date=20 September 2025}} By early 2025, Paytm partnered with Agoda to provide hotel booking options in India and overseas markets.{{cite news |title=Paytm Travel, Agoda partner to offer hotel bookings across destinations |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/hotels-/-restaurants/paytm-travel-agoda-partner-to-offer-hotel-bookings-across-indian-global-destinations-on-paytm-app/articleshow/118108045.cms |work=Economic Times |date=10 February 2025 |access-date=20 September 2025}} == Funding == In October 2011, One97 Communications received funding of $10 million from [[Sapphire Ventures]].{{cite news |last1=Abrar |first1=Peerzada |title=SAP invests $10m in Delhi-based One97 Communications |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech-news/sap-invests-10m-in-delhi-based-one97-communications/articleshow/10311956.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=11 October 2011}} In January 2015, news|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/ratan-tata-invests-in-paytm-joins-as-adviser/story-qKceLOORNLNYWfBsokqW4M.html|title=Ratan Tata invests in Paytm, joins as adviser|work=Hindustan Times}} In March 2015, Ratan Tata made a personal investment in One97 Communications's Paytm and joined as an adviser of the company. It received funding of $60 million from [[MediaTek]]'s investment funds Mountain Capital, which made the company's valuation at $4.8 billion in August 2016.{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Digbijay |title=Mediatek invests $60m in Paytm at $4.8bn |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/deals/-ma/Mediatek-invests-60m-in-Paytm-at-4-8bn-valuation/articleshow/53921168.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=30 August 2016}} In May 2017, the company raised $1.4 billion from Japan's [[SoftBank Group]], which made its valuation jumped to over $8 billion.{{cite news |last1=Chanchani |first1=Madhav |last2=Variyar |first2=Mugdha |title=Paytm raises $1.4 billion from Softbank, valuation jumps to over $8 billion |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/money/paytm-raises-1-4-billion-from-softbank-valuation-jumps-to-over-8-billion/articleshow/58733667.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=19 May 2017}} Paytm raised $300 million from Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway in September 2018.{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/paytm-raises-660-million/cid/1726660|title=Paytm raises $660 million|work=Telegraph India}}{{cite news |last1=Purnell |first1=Newley |last2=Friedman |first2=Nicole |title=Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Invests in India Mobile-Payments Firm |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/buffetts-berkshire-hathaway-eyes-india-mobile-payments-firm-1535372330 |publisher=[[The Wall Street Journal]] |date=27 August 2018}}{{cite news |title=Berkshire Hathaway Invests in India's One97 Communications |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-27/warren-buffett-is-said-to-agree-on-backing-india-s-paytm |publisher=[[Bloomberg News]] |date=27 August 2018}} In November 2019, the company secured $1 billion in a Series G funding led by T Rowe Price and existing investors Ant Financial and [[SoftBank Vision Fund]]. [[Robert Citrone|Discovery Capital]] also participated in the round.{{cite news |last1=Shrivastava |first1=Aditi |title=Paytm gets $1 billion topup in latest financing round |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/newsbuzz/paytm-gets-1-billion-topup-in-latest-financing-round/articleshow/72216174.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=25 November 2019}} Paytm raised Rs 9,000 crore ($1.4 billion) from SoftBank.{{cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/money/paytm-raises-1-4-billion-from-softbank-valuation-jumps-to-over-8-billion/articleshow/58733667.cms|title=Paytm raises $1.4 billion from Softbank, valuation jumps to over $8 billion|work=Economic Times}} == Acquisition == In December 2012, the company acquired MobiVite, a [[mobile marketing]] platform{{cite news |last1=Abrar |first1=Peerzada |title=One97 Communications acquires MobiVite to consolidate footing in mobile marketing space |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/internet/one97-communications-acquires-mobivite-to-consolidate-footing-in-mobile-marketing-space/articleshow/17657921.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=18 December 2012}} followed by the acquisition of Plustx, a cross-messaging platform in August 2013.{{cite news |last1=Abrar |first1=Peerzada |title=One97 acquires local language messaging startup Plustxt |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/one97-acquires-local-language-messaging-startup-plustxt/articleshow/21711557.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=8 August 2013}} == IPO == One97 Communications was scheduled to launch its IPO In November 2010. However, losses narrowed to Rs 1,701 crore during this year, compared to Rs 2,942 crore loss reported in the fiscal year 2020.{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Digbijay |last2=Manikandan |first2=Ashwin |title=IPO-bound Paytm's revenue drops 14% in FY21, losses narrow to Rs 1,701 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/ipo-bound-paytm-sees-revenue-decline-by-14-losses-drop-to-rs-1701-crore-in-fy21/articleshow/83256611.cms?from=mdr |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=5 June 2021}} One97 Communications reduced losses by 28% to Rs 2,833 crore in the FY 2019-20. extract:
One97 Communications Ltd. is an Indian multinational technology company, headquartered in Noida. It was founded in 2000 by Vijay Shekhar Sharma.  Through its subsidiaries and businesses, the company offers digital payment and financial services to consumers and merchants in India. It also provides mobile advertising, marketing and payments for merchants.
In 2021, the company became publicly listed after the largest ever initial public offering (IPO) in India's history. It was listed on Indian stock exchanges on 08 November 2021.
